titulo: One more minute for the soup
caption:
One more minute for the soup

"Lukewarm is fine." "One more minute." The pot started to rattle, and the soup came out steaming.

One more minute on the heat turns lukewarm soup into soup that steams.

For whoever heats it one more minute before serving.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a counter on the right and a soup pot with a lid on it. A brick-red block figure with narrowed eyes says lukewarm is fine. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers one more minute, and the pot rattles and steam rises while its lid lifts. The red one's eyes go wide and says ...steaming. better. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me, one more minute on the heat.
